name: Lebsa Lorace
source:
Lebsa was adopted by the Handels when she became an adult and became a Lord due to her excellent battle ability and reputation.

Her battle ability is truly astounding; according to her, she is the disciple of Hero Asbell.

Her looks and status allowed her to be popular among teenagers. But underneath all that, she has occasional outbursts of emotional instability and seems like she has an unknown past...

[Edited from in-game bio]
